entries.name: Text-to-LoRA
entries.text: A network built to generate add-on weights for another model from a task description. The list above treats weight generators as their own kind. They sit here because the model receiving the weights is not trained.

evidence.passage: Networks built to generate weights for other models.
The best-known weight generator is Text-to-LoRA

OTHER + learned weight generator.

entries.name: GPT-6 Astra edits Qwen3.5-0.8B
entries.text: With Python and no training, OpenAI’s model worked out an edit to about 0.016% of the weights of a far smaller open model. On the largest of three test-run budgets, the small model’s maths score rose from 8% to 48%. Most of the gain came from fixing a fault that made it repeat itself. A blog post, not peer-reviewed.

evidence.passage: published on 2 November and not peer-reviewed
